implementation_consequences: Range-2/3 end logic stores wick/body range before calculating bounded-array variance, with open versus range-edge anchors. Publish projections only after the completed range is available; preserve estimator, anchor and inclusion convention explicitly.
Computation reads box coordinates at range end while box creation/update is show_box gated. Numerical state must be independent of drawing visibility and missing box handles.

First-hit counters independently mark each side by inclusive high/low tests; both-hit totals are committed only at the next session start while total_sessions increments at range end. These are touch/co-occurrence counts, not verified first-direction or ordered opposite-hit outcomes. Freeze observation horizon and mark the current unfinished outcome censored.
No-observation denominators become zero percentages. Retain eligible counts and unavailable estimates separately; line extension and table regeneration do not republish or extend prediction validity.

Five fixed/custom ET sessions track start OHLC and completed end values. Version civil session membership/trading date, bar completeness and close[1] boundary semantics; doji sessions are classified bullish and zero-open sessions are skipped by the source.

Start thresholds freeze historical quantiles, but f_record_session pushes the just-finished outcome then recomputes touch thresholds. Its retrace flags still use start thresholds. A causal implementation must retain the exact pre-outcome threshold version with each outcome and avoid this mixed/self-included denominator.

MFE means high-open and MAE means open-low for every session; bearish subsets later plot bear_mfe below open and bear_mae above. Preserve coordinate meaning and test this sign/label mismatch before claiming literal or corrected parity.

Combined arrays retain 100 sessions and bull/bear arrays each retain 100 members independently, while touch and bull/bear counters are cumulative. Every estimate needs its exact cohort/window, eligible denominator and sample minimum; the displayed N=100 does not qualify all counts.

Nearest-rank quantiles require five samples, mean requires two. Same-bar high/low touch followed by close retrace is a bar event, not an inferred intrabar execution sequence. Final bull/bear conditioning is ex-post and cannot select a live cohort in advance.

Weekday denominators increment on session start and ten flags record inclusive touches of open +/- 0.5,1,2,3,4 SD. Touch weekday is taken again on each bar, so an overnight session can split numerator and denominator dates. Bind events to one explicit session trading date and require eligible scale evidence.

Reversal arrays and loops have nine entries although sd_levels has eleven; +3/+4 branches are unreachable in the shown 0..8 loops. Make grid cardinality and index mapping explicit and test every enabled level.

All hit flags update before reversal loops in the same bar; source-to-target co-occurrences including self hits do not establish a later reversal. Require ordered observations or label ambiguous/co-occurring outcomes.
Total-day deduplication uses dayofmonth alone and percentages show 0 for empty denominators. Use full session identity and separate missing/censored cohorts from measured zero.

implementation_consequences: Profiles redistribute lower-timeframe OHLC volume across body and twice-weighted wicks, split wick volume equally into green/red. These are approximate bar allocations, not aggressor trades; retain measure/aggregation lineage and zero-height/missing-data behavior.

calcSession rebuilds fixed-count descending bins from session high/low, so grid changes with range. Require explicit row boundaries, exact units, mass checks and immutable completed profiles before cross-session comparison.

POC uses strict greater-than ties and returns na for the final bin. Value-area expansion alternates down then up and checks threshold before updating that side boundary. Freeze tie/expansion convention and test last-bin POC, already-covered POC, zero mass and crossing-bin inclusion.

Live drawing deletes/recreates handles and display normalization sums separate green/red maxima. Numerical profile and causal publication must not depend on render handles or display widths; Open Interest and Volume remain distinct measures.

ADR arrays start with zero placeholders; rolling highs/lows start at zero, and regular-session-lastbar[1] resets define the day. Do not treat placeholders or partial first sessions as observed ranges; bind completed sessions and tick-rounding convention.

Session arrays insert zero current-session placeholders at start and fill at end. Means/day-of-week statistics can include the unfinished zero; compute prior completed cohorts separately with explicit sample membership.
London/Asia containment uses strict inequalities after London end and preserves one condition until reset. Equal boundaries and partial/missing sessions need declared states and publication cut.

Dynamic probability table contains literal percentage strings such as 72.33 and 81.51. They have no estimated cohort in these clauses; retain as unvalidated source assertions until dated counts/denominators and out-of-sample evidence exist.

implementation_consequences: Confirmed-bar logic reads [1] OHLC/VWAP but gates on current rth_session, introducing a publication lag and potential first/last-session boundary mismatch. Retain event time, receipt/completion time and source-session membership separately.

Retests require same close side on consecutive evaluated bars plus a strict wick penetration; crossover uses a boolean rv>sv, with equality included in false. Freeze exact inequality and dedup/event definitions rather than infer executable fills.

Daily win/loss commits stop once stat_total=maxDays, while intraday timing arrays roll and bucket counts accumulate. These are different cohorts; preserve per-event/per-session membership and remove counts consistently if a rolling estimator is intended.

Band SD is sqrt(weighted dev^2), an RMS about changing per-bar midpoint VWAP anchors, not centered variance. MAD is median(abs(dev)), not deviations around a fitted median. Name estimators accurately and retain each anchor/version; volume-weighted RMS and unweighted interpolated quantiles have different measures.

Current-bar deviation accumulation and drawing must be provisional until bar publication. Session returns require nonzero denominator, exact end close, and declared ex-post win labels distinct from forecast performance.

implementation_consequences: Assigned clauses contain user quantile settings and render extensions for TF1..TF4 gated by is_new_candle[1]. The extension endpoint is a drawing artifact, not a known-time forecast horizon.

Preserve quantile percentages, manipulation/distribution sign labels and independent timeframe identities. This assigned fragment does not contain the estimator; combine with prior inspected clauses before asserting sample/cohort or HTF confirmation semantics.

Expansive T-spot creation compares three closed HTF candles and a log midpoint, with one-created gating and bounded display arrays. Preserve exact candle sequence, midpoint domain, bias evidence and distinct event/publication clocks.
Pivot confirmation uses two right bars but draws back at bar_index[2]. Backdated drawings cannot become information at the pivot time; carry confirmation delay and actual creation time.

Latest T-spot touch uses strict open/high/low penetration and close reversal; later pivot-cross confirmation consumes the touched state. Freeze state lineage, event ordering, replacement/reset and duplicate alert behavior.

Against-trend spots are made transparent and can be shown again; this is not permanent semantic invalidation. Main processing is restricted to last_bar_index-1000, so visible history is endpoint-dependent and cannot certify prefix invariance.
Backward C2 lookup and extrema scans need declared bounded history and missing evidence handling; optional close-line arrays must not be assumed index-aligned with every box.

BB uses SMA/stdev while KC uses SMA of true range or high-low; momentum is linear regression of close minus a high/low/SMA midpoint. Retain separate lengths/multipliers, range mode, warmup and equality/no-squeeze behavior.
Divergence compares oscillator pivots and associated price after lbR future bars, then plots offset -lbR. Publish only at pivot confirmation; event coordinate and knowledge time differ.

Repaint gate defaults to not delaying until close. Provisional real-time signals must be versioned/retracted or withheld until a confirmed bar; regular/hidden and bullish/bearish variants need distinct frozen identities.

Five parameterized workflows separate range formation, high/low check, and retracement windows. Level is low+(high-low)*percentage; draw extension adds fixed daily seconds. Use calendar intervals and a publication cut after formation, not a 24-hour drawing as validity.

High/low flags are inclusive, independent per side; retrace requires bar high/low contain the level. Overlapping user windows or partial/missing formation can mix condition and outcome; validate interval order and freeze conditional cohort at outcome start.

Total sessions increments at formation start, so incomplete/current observations enter source denominators. Conditional success divides by max(count,1); keep censored outcomes and empty denominators explicit.

Assigned start branches reset high/low flags but do not show returned reset; other source clauses must establish the full reset lifecycle before implementation. ret_distance unshift clauses show no local bound; impose registered retention and sample identity rather than silent unbounded growth.

The only newly assigned lines are a blank and the heading Retracement logic for each level. They add no executable semantics or estimator evidence. F09 must rely on the previously inspected substantive clauses, not claim fresh behavioral verification from this fragment.

Open hits use full bar containment, while likely-high hits require the bar high itself inside the box and likely-low hits require the bar low itself inside the box. A bar crossing completely through the zone is excluded by this rule. Register exact touch versus overlap/overshoot semantics.
Display actual percentage divides range by current low, while completed range_pcts divides by open. Keep these separate units/denominators and reject zero/nonpositive-domain assumptions.

Running ranges and hit flags mutate inside the session, then final values are stored at session end. Separate provisional live state from completed statistical samples and make drawing visibility independent of computation; weekday hit tables need exact eligible cohort counts.

Newly assigned clauses draw and delete open/retracement labels at time plus fixed daily seconds. Preserve target/open/retracement semantic identities separately from visual endpoint and avoid interpreting a 24-hour extension as exchange-session duration or fresh publication.
This fragment contains no estimator or outcome transitions; combine with prior inspected logic before asserting conditional counts or reset correctness.

Open Interest source requests daily delta OI for intraday futures, optionally replacing EMA(5) volume in lower-timeframe OHLC requests. A daily OI delta is not traded volume or a fresh per-subbar observation; require availability, missing-symbol, repetition and measure-unit evidence.

OHLC volume allocation weights wicks twice, direction follows candle body, and zero-height terms pass through nz. Keep proxy allocation distinct from tape aggressor flow; test zero-range mass and negative OI separately.
POC last-bin exclusion and VA crossing-bin boundary omission match the shown profile family. Freeze corrected versus literal convention with bin-grid, tie, mass and threshold tests.
Bin count has a rendering box budget; retained numerical history needs its own declared capacity and cannot silently disappear when chart objects are pruned.
Each new weekday inserts zeros into every weekday array; each bar containing a level increments the current-day cell. Counts are repeated bar touches, not one-hit days or independent weekly trials.

Tables divide weekday hit totals by all hit totals, yielding share of touches rather than hit probability conditional on an eligible weekday. Retain opportunity/exposure denominators and explicitly handle no hits.

Total weeks is approximated by day-array length/7 despite missing market days and partial coverage. Use actual calendar week/session identities, completed IB availability and bounded per-session outcomes; first-bar array initialization must be explicit.

Preset choices alter sensitivity, overlays and even MACD lengths via candleColorType. Effective configuration must be immutable and hashed; presentation settings cannot silently modify an allegedly identical numerical candidate.

Trend strength comments describe ADX but code is clipped (close-VWMA)/ATR scaled to +/-100; volatility is ATR/close scaled/capped. Labels such as AI, probability or optimal sensitivity supply no calibration evidence; retain actual formula, domain and warmup.

Squeeze uses BB within ATR KC and absolute regression momentum normalized by trailing maximum. Gaussian and rational-quadratic kernels are causal trailing smoothers, while the latter hybrid band is mean absolute error around current estimate plus ATR. They are not estimated event probabilities.

Volume proxy assigns entire candle volume by close-location/body/tick heuristics, then dashboard sentiment doubles signed values using a hard threshold 50. Preserve proxy and volume units; do not claim aggressor/orderflow or percent sentiment.

Recursive SuperSmoother/neo-cloud state and 365-bar ATR warmup need deterministic initialization and bounded state. Positive/negative plot offsets are display coordinates, not availability; integer truncation of cloud sums is another explicit transform.
get_mae_pct maps named hours to hard-coded constants and defaults to 0.50. Drawing filters by supplied hit_rate and colors by MAE constants; neither is recomputed evidence in this fragment.

Inclusive high/low containment deletes hit display objects and marks session booleans. Keep immutable level birth/hit/deletion lineage and observation horizon so deletion does not erase statistical evidence; rates need dated level-specific eligible denominators.

Runners draw 75/100/125/150/200 percent range offsets in the direction determined by break side, displaying conditional percentages and fixed action labels. Preserve the conditional target-hit cohort and exact signed anchor transform.

UI distinguishes Forming, In Progress, Won, Invalidated, No Break and only shows runners after target hit. Outcome/censoring state must be explicit; displayed zone win rates and median time require separately evidenced sample populations and cannot justify execution actions on their own.
This assigned fragment is predominantly display logic; no fresh claim about the rate estimator, entry/stop sequence or native economic validation is made.

Assigned clauses extend existing Asia/London/hourly/midnight line and label endpoints during NY or a 16:00-16:01 window. This changes presentation only; original level receipt, validity and session lineage must remain fixed.
No new estimator or probability computation appears in the assigned fragment. Other independently inspected clauses are required for its statistical semantics.

Close-above/below counts compare against current averages, but eviction recomputes averages after removal and subtracts based on those new thresholds. This is not an inverse of the original contribution and can drift even with max(0) clamps. Retain per-outcome frozen threshold and boolean contribution for exact rolling eviction.

Bull/bear counts and several parallel arrays are removed in lockstep. Persist one typed session record/cohort identity and rebuild deterministically; sample counts must match exactly the numerator membership.

Lower and upper alert conditions all call crossover, including lower levels, and display toggles gate alerts. Freeze direction/equality/availability and separate presentation controls from numerical signal identity; moving averages must not cause undocumented threshold-cross events.
